description: Manual review decisions for identity images, made from contact sheets (tools/etl/contact_sheet.py). reject: Commons file -> reason (never shipped). period: Commons file -> [from, to, reason] replaces a period inferred from the polity's lifetime. Rule applied when reviewing: a symbol must be attested for the polity in the period shown; present-day symbols, later versions, conjectural or unsourced reconstructions are rejected.

reject.Flag of Waldeck before 1830.svg: file is the pre-1830 flag; period inferred from the polity lifetime would show it after 1830
reject.Fictitious Ottoman flag 3.svg: Commons labels this flag fictitious (the three-crescent flag is a European misattribution)
reject.State Flag of Greece (1863-1924 and 1935: flag of 1863 onwards; the 1832-1862 royal flag differs
reject.Gwalior Coat of arms.png: princely-state arms designed for the 1877 Imperial Assemblage; not in use in 1836
reject.Baroda State CoA.png: princely-state arms designed for the 1877 Imperial Assemblage; not in use in 1836
reject.Flag of Thailand.svg: modern Thai tricolour (1917); Siam used a plain red flag in 1836
reject.Flag of Hawaii (1896).svg: 1896 version of the flag; earlier versions differ
reject.Kanem flag from dulcerta 1339-pt.svg: flag drawn on a 1339 portolan chart; not the 19th-century Bornu state
reject.Flag of Ashanti.svg: modern flag of the Asante kingdom (20th century)
reject.Dahomey flag 1889.svg: flag documented for 1889 (Behanzin); not attested for 1836
reject.Flag of Zulu.png: no attested flag of the Zulu kingdom; modern design without source
reject.Red flag.svg: generic red flag, not specific to the Aussa sultanate
reject.Flag of the Trucial States (1968–1971).s: flag of the 1968-1971 Trucial States Council
reject.Vicente Rocafuerte (cropped).jpg: image cropped from a modern banknote, not a portrait
